summary: The speaker explains why the current architecture accumulates hidden coupling, then proposes explicit ownership boundaries and a staged migration that preserves working behavior while moving responsibilities behind stable interfaces.
keyIdeas: Hidden ownership is more expensive than visible duplication.
Migration order should follow dependency direction rather than file structure.
Visualizing the runtime boundary exposes coupling the module graph hides.

segments.title: The real boundary problem
segments.summary: The talk reframes the problem from module organization to runtime ownership: several modules can import cleanly while still sharing lifecycle and state in ways that force them to load together.
segments.whyItMatters: This changes what should be measured and where a migration boundary belongs.

visuals.reason: architecture diagram showing the shared runtime boundary
